description: Get NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day — daily curated space image or video with expert explanation, dating back to 1995 (NASA APOD)

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today). Returns the Astronomy Picture of the Day for that date

thumbs.description: Return thumbnail URL for video APOD entries (default false)

name: nasa.astronomy.apod

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Astronomy Picture of the Day
